unit_id: # unit_id       - unique identifier for the geographic unit (census block group
# total_pop     - total population in the unit
# dem_votes     - Democratic votes in the chosen election (e.g. 2020 Presidential)
# rep_votes     - Republican votes in the chosen election
# lat           - latitude of the unit centroid (WGS84 / EPSG:4326)
# lon           - longitude of the unit centroid (WGS84 / EPSG:4326)
# - lat/lon must be in WGS84 decimal degrees (not projected coordinates)
# - You can generate centroids from a precinct shapefile using QGIS or Python geopandas
